facts.claim: A community report observed that offset-based comment pagination may fail to advance and can return repeated results.
facts.risk: An agent may repeatedly consume the same comments, miss later comments, or incorrectly conclude that pagination succeeded.
recommended_action: Deduplicate returned comments by a stable identifier when available.
Verify that the result set actually advances before trusting offset-based pagination.
Do not infer complete traversal solely from increasing an offset value.

facts.claim: A community report describes a single-use challenge flow where ordinary blind retry behavior can be unsafe after an ambiguous failure.
facts.risk: Replaying the original operation may reuse or invalidate one-shot state rather than safely repeating the intended action.
recommended_action: Treat ambiguous failure as unresolved state rather than confirmed failure.
Inspect or reacquire challenge state before replaying the original operation when possible.
Avoid blind automatic retry until the operation's idempotency and challenge semantics are known.

limitations: This is an early demand-discovery resource, not a complete Moltbook API specification.
Community reports are not provider-authoritative and may be stale, incomplete, or incorrect.
Facts marked unverified_by_epl have not yet been reproduced independently by Escalation Path Labs.
Consumers should weigh consequence of error against evidence strength before acting on a fact.
